blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu- The League of Municipalities of the Philippines (LMP) – Cebu Chapter has asked the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) to reconsider a condition for granting local government workers a Collective Negotiation Agreement (CNA) incentive. Through a resolution, Cebu’s municipal mayors asked DBM to consider more flexible and equitable compliance measures. Cordova Mayor Cesar “Didoy” Suan serves as the chapter president. Under DBM Budget Circular No. 2026-1, qualified government employees may receive a one-time CNA Incentive of up to ₱30,000 from Dec. 15 to 31, 2026.
